cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Record My Contribution
cards.instruction: Get your contribution formally recognized, recorded, or repeated where it cannot be quietly forgotten.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Please put 'roof repaired by Pat' in the village minutes.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We all know you fixed it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. The minutes weren't there with a ladder. They need telling.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We'll thank you at the party.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: After the roof line, write 'thanks pending' so we remember.

mechanism: A treats its former minute-taking pupil public gratitude as incomplete record-keeping until A roof repair and promised thanks are both written down.
confusable: Not simply seeking praise in the moment: A insists on durable attribution even when everyone present already knows.
comparison: Village minutes and promised thanks versus certificate containing each team role.
seedUse: D177 Pat/roof/ladder/minutes/party/thanks pending; S05 recording beyond memory.
